biggest_catch: Both you and your friend only get the $100 after the friend completes 10 qualifying transactions in the first 30 days AND keeps the accounts open and in good standing for 90 days - the bonus is deposited within 120 days of account opening, so expect a ~4-month wait.
catches: Referrer must be 18+, in good standing, and primary on a BECU Member Share or Member Advantage savings account; BECU employees, joint account holders, and business/fiduciary/HSA/Zero Dividend/Early Saver holders cannot refer.

Friend must be a new member within BECU's field of membership (WA all counties, select OR/ID counties, or nationwide via partner association such as KEXP) and must not have been a BECU member in the past 6 months.
Friend must open checking AND savings using promo code REFER plus the referrer's unique referral code at application - BECU will not pay for accounts opened without both codes.
Within the first 30 days, friend must complete 10 required transactions (debit/credit card purchases, checks, deposits/withdrawals via checking).
Both accounts must remain open and in good standing for at least 90 days; bonus deposited to the Member Share/Advantage savings account within 120 days of opening.
Offer valid 1/1/2026 - 12/31/2026; no referral-count cap stated on the current program page.
Bonus reported as income (1099-INT for new member; may be 1099-MISC for referrer) per BECU's published referral terms.

steps: Share your unique BECU referral code and promo code REFER with friends.
Friend joins BECU by opening a checking and savings account using promo code REFER and your unique referral code.
Within the first 30 days, friend completes 10 required transactions (card purchases, checks, deposits/withdrawals).
Both keep accounts open and in good standing for 90 days; you and your friend each receive a $100 bonus deposit within 120 days of account opening.
timing: $100 bonus deposited to Member Share/Advantage savings within 120 days of the friend opening qualifying accounts (after 10 transactions in 30 days + 90 days open).
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: $100 bonus deposited to Member Share/Advantage savings within 120 days of the friend opening qualifying accounts (after 10 transactions in 30 days + 90 days open). — structural: payout can take up to ~120 days from account opening.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The 30-day payout window is the binding constraint after qualification — nothing in the terms shortens it; compress the qualification leg instead.
The 90-day seasoning/hold is structural — pick a different referral program if you need money sooner.
